description: This file defines an enum 'Sensor' representing various sensor types used in the rusefi automotive control software. It includes sensor properties such as name, category, data type, measurement units, offset, color coding for UI, and value ranges. The enum provides methods for sensor lookup, categorization, and processing certain sensor values. It serves as a central repository for sensor definitions and their attributes within the project.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: Enumeration representing various sensor types with associated properties and methods for usage within the automotive control system.

methods.name: getSensorsForCategory
methods.description: Returns a collection of Sensor enums belonging to the specified category, sorted alphabetically by name.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Looks up a Sensor enum by its name string; returns a default Sensor if not found.

methods.name: processAdvance
methods.description: Normalizes advance angles to within -360 to 360 degrees.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the sensor.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the sensor.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the measurement units associated with the sensor.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum value the sensor can measure.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum value the sensor can measure.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with the sensor for UI display.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value for the sensor measurement.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the sensor's value.

methods.name: translateValue
methods.description: Applies specific transformations to sensor values, especially for advance and timing sensors.
